## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm test:run`
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm run build`
- [ ] I manually tested relevant behavior in Typora, or explained why manual testing is not applicable.
- [ ] I included screenshots or a recording for visual changes, or marked them not applicable.

## Implementation safety

- [ ] Event listeners, observers, timers, commands, and views are cleaned up when the plugin unloads.
- [ ] I updated public documentation for user-visible behavior, or marked it not applicable.
- [ ] I described any change to the packaged plugin files or release process.

## Privacy and release safety

- [ ] I did not add personal information, secrets, private paths, or confidential document content.
- [ ] I did not add generated release archives or local development artifacts.
- [ ] User-facing behavior and documentation are updated where needed.
